\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{automata,arrows.meta}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Stealth,every state/.style={fill=green!10}]
  \node[state,accepting above,accepting text=finish] (top) at (0,0) {$q_0$};
  \node[state,accepting right,accepting distance=5ex] (right) at (3,0) {$q_1$};
  \node[state,accepting below,accepting text=halt] (bottom) at (0,-2.5) {$q_2$};
  \node[state,accepting left,accepting text=done] (left) at (3,-2.5) {$q_3$};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
